cohort: This study included 30 autopsy cases of pulmonary thromboembolism.
finding: An appropriate observation and prophylaxis is essential in patients with risk factors for PTE and the role of forensic pathologist is important to perform an autopsy and review medical records for medical dispute about PTE.
